==Overview==
An [[Aggelos]] with humanoid shape, the Effigy is flexible in movement while packing a punch in offensive, making it a threat if uncautious, especially with its abilities:

*Two swings that deals Physical damage to Operators at front.
*A ground slam with its arm that deals heavy Physical damage and knocks Operators back after a long wind-up.
*A ground slam after a leap that deals heavy Physical damage and knocks Operators back.
*Several swings and thrusts that deals Physical damage, followed by an upward swing that deals Physical damage to Operators at front.
*Morphs into a cannon shape, and fires laser after a short charge up, dealing continuous Æther damage. This ability can be interrupted.
*Attempt to capture an Operator, and if success, continuously deal Physical damage. After a charge up, deals heavy Physical damage and knock the Operator back. This ability can be interrupted.
*Fires three energy spheres, dealing Æther damage. Two [[Ram]]s and one [[Sting]] will be summoned after hitting the ground, which also make it affected by Blight for a short period, dealing continuous Æther damage to Operators on it.
